segments.text:
You wait for good, and it comes not; but is
your will brought to a due submission to the
Will of God about it? Certainly God will have
you come to this before you enjoy your desires.
Enjoyment of your desires is the thing that will
please you, but resignation of your wills, is that
which is pleasing to God: if your hearts cannot
come to this, mercies cannot come to you. David
was made to wait long for the mercy promised
him, yea, and to be content without it before he
enjoyed it, Psal. 131. 2 he was brought to be
as a weaned Child, and so must you.
